basic_info.description: Welcome to a quintessential Presidio Heights condominium on a prestigious block - an elegant blend of classic San Francisco architecture and modern comfort. This 3-bed/2-bath home is thoughtfully designed with luminous spaces, high ceilings, and a versatile layout. The gracious double parlor features a front living room with bay windows, built-in bookcases, and a fireplace, plus an attached sitting room ideal for an office, guest space, or media room. Two of the bedrooms anchor the home: one at the front with a closet w/ wash basin & the primary at the rear with a large en-suite bath (shower + tub) and expansive walk-in closet. A third smaller bedroom sits at the center, across from a full bath. Original details -moldings, millwork, vintage glass - coexist with upgrades including a renovated kitchen w/ BlueStar range and stone-tiled bathrooms. The large rear dining rm is perfect for entertaining with a lovely Juliet balcony. Access to a shared rooftop offers beautiful Golden Gate Bridge views. In-unit laundry, one-car garage parking. All this just steps from the Presidio, Michelin-rated dining, boutiques, and top schools. A rare opportunity to enjoy timeless elegance and modern living in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods.
